rationale: Crash on v6.48.0 in AgentCore gateway/target code. v6.49.0, released the day before the issue, fixes a gateway_target panic that was a v6.48.0 regression. The issue names no aws_* resource, only 'Gateway (MCP) + 1 Target', so triage_checks.py will not match the release note to it. Predicted to fail.
maintainer_history: Maintainer replied that it was fixed in v6.49.0 via #48215 and closed it 17 minutes after it was opened.
